seo_title: Xero vs MYOB Business: 2026 Payroll & API Audit
meta_description: Technical comparison of Xero and MYOB Business for Australian BAS, payroll, and bank feed integration. Find the right architecture for your business size.
direct_verdict: Xero is the superior choice for high-growth firms requiring robust API integrations and ecosystem scalability. MYOB Business is the more cost-effective solution for small Australian entities prioritizing native, AI-assisted BAS compliance and simplified payroll.

comparison_matrix.product_a_spec: Direct bank feeds with high-confidence JAX matching
comparison_matrix.product_b_spec: Unlimited bank account connections on Pro/Plus plans

product_a_pros: Superior API ecosystem and third-party integration depth
Advanced JAX automation for high-volume transaction matching

product_a_cons: High monthly subscription costs for mid-market scaling
Additional fees for users exceeding plan limits
product_b_pros: Lower total cost of ownership for unlimited payroll and users
Integrated AI-BAS features reduce manual compliance overhead
Native inventory management included in higher tiers
product_b_cons: Limited API throughput compared to Xero's developer ecosystem
Desktop-dependent architecture for advanced features like Premier
hidden_gotchas: Buyers often overlook the hidden costs of Xero's 'per-user' and 'per-bill' pricing models, which can inflate monthly invoices significantly as headcount grows. Conversely, MYOB users frequently encounter friction when attempting to integrate niche third-party SaaS tools due to a less mature API developer portal. Both platforms utilize aggressive introductory discounting, but users must audit their actual usage against plan limits—specifically payroll headcount and user seats—before the promo period expires to avoid sudden, steep price hikes.
